## Checklist

<!-- All items should be checked before requesting review. -->

- [ ] Tests pass locally (`python -m unittest discover -s pyutils_generic/tests -p 'test_*.py'`)
- [ ] I added/updated tests covering my change
- [ ] `pylint pyutils_generic --fail-under=9.0` is clean
- [ ] Documentation under `docs/` and/or `README.md` is updated (for user-facing changes)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated under `[Unreleased]` (for notable changes)
- [ ] My PR is focused on a single logical change
